text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in Norwegian papers this morning:
- Several houses were destroyed by fires during the Christmas holidays. Two people died in blazes.

- In a letter to Aftenposten, Russia's ambassador in Norway, Jurij Fokine, thanks the Norwegian rescue team who helped the passengers in a Russian airplane which crashed on the island of Frans Josefs Land on Christmas Eve.
- Queen Sonja visited on Christmas Eve children at Rikshospitalet who were too sick to go home for Christmas.
- Domestic flight traffic in Norway at Scandinavian Airline Systems (SAS) has grown 13 percent so far in 1996.

- Norway's Export Council will open an office in Turkey in 1997. Eirik Wiken at the Export Council says Turkey is a growing market for Norwegian business. In the past year Norwegian exports to Turkey have increased by 40 percent.
